desc: 透明盒身一眼看清存了什么，多规格可叠放，台面冰箱不再乱
leaf: 带锁扣透明食品储物保鲜盒
name: 透明锁扣可叠放保鲜盒套款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：用干净侧轮廓交代套装可嵌套叠放的形态与容量层次
放大冰箱与台面上零散容器互相挤靠、盖子不配对的老问题，为套装铺垫解决时刻
一秒讲清核心利益：透明盒身让每一层存了什么一眼可见，叠成一列还省空间
让买家把自己代入每周备餐与剩菜收纳的真实厨房，建立尺寸参照
用结构与工艺特写证明盒盖的扣合构造与盒壁通透度，替代任何口头主张
把深浅不一的多规格排成一列供买家自选并暗示成套购买，消除规格疑虑
近距特写单只斜置盒体，用可见内容物证明通透度与扣合到位，制造动感记忆点
收口消除清洗与归置顾虑：盖体可拆、盒身可直立沥干，结构耐用感落地

style.backgroundSystem: seamless clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, warm limestone beige #F2EEE8 for benefit and variant screens, pale stone counter and brushed steel for real kitchen scenes; one background per shot, never mixed within a shot
style.direction: clean bright kitchenware commerce with a tidy stack-driven visual grammar
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons only, accent colour #5E8C4A, used never as badges or seals
style.lightingSystem: bright neutral-cool high-key studio light, large front-left softbox key with a bounce fill on the shadow side, crisp thin speculars along transparent walls, true soft contact shadows that always ground the stack, no harsh blowout
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium kitchenware ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm limestone beige #F2EEE8, dark grey hardware #3A3F42 and one fresh produce green accent #5E8C4A; bright neutral-cool high-key studio lighting with a large front-left softbox key, bounce fill and true soft contact shadows; seamless white for packshots, warm limestone beige for benefit and variant screens, pale stone counter or brushed steel for real kitchen scenes; modern geometric sans-serif with at most one minimal label; consistent thin single-weight line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic restraint; transparent bodies always read as colourless see-through walls with the dark grey latch hardware on the same two sides, stable slight 3/4 to 90-degree side angles and constant relative scale across a stack; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no rearranged or relocated latch hardware
style.presentationRules: transparent bodies always read as colourless see-through walls with the dark grey #3A3F42 latch hardware on the same two sides in every shot; stable slight 3/4 to 90-degree side angles; constant relative scale between units in a stack; rims never clipped by the frame
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale stone island #E9E6E1, neutral studio board #E4E0DA and brushed steel drainboard #C9CDD0 as the only stage surfaces
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif reserved for at most one minimal label; no serif, handwritten or retro lettering
